title: Dual public paths: handler modules and types capability
description: Follow-up from JMAP-wf92.13 (which fixed crate::backend::X vs crate::X in server crates). Same one-public-path rule still broken elsewhere: (1) server handler modules are pub mod AND re-exported at root, e.g. jmap_mail_server::email::handle_email_get and jmap_mail_server::handle_email_get; same in every extension server. (2) types crates expose capability URIs at both jmap_X_types::capability::JMAP_X_URI and jmap_X_types::JMAP_X_URI. Fix canonical mail first: make the module private where the root re-export covers every pub item, else drop the root re-export. Check each module for pub items not re-exported before privatising. BREAKING.
